fields.description: Show the Add-ons area (LLM / storage services) in the console. Off hides its nav entry and blocks its routes.
fields.label: Enable Add-ons

fields.description: Minutes a trial server may sit idle before its region puts it to sleep. Customer traffic wakes it. Set 0 to keep trial servers awake. Paid servers do not use idle sleep. Resizing disables idle sleep.
fields.label: Trial Idle Shutdown (Minutes)

fields.description: Days a team invitation stays open. Resending it starts the count again.
fields.label: Invitation Expiry (Days)

fields.description: Base domain of every regional service. Central reaches proxy.<region>.<wildcard domain>, atlas.<region>.<wildcard domain>, and cargo.<region>.<wildcard domain>. Example: frappe.dev
fields.label: Wildcard Domain

fields.description: This Central's id in Atlas's Configure Webhooks call. Atlas refuses anything but 1 unless its developer mode is on or it allows multiple Central webhooks -- raise this only where more than one Central environment shares an Atlas.
fields.label: Central ID

fields.description: A JSON object that every server Central creates merges into its sites/common_site_config.json, such as {"raven_push_notification_server_url": "https://cloud.ravenchat.ai"}. The customer can read it, so never put a secret here. A server keeps what it got when it was created.
fields.label: Common Site Config

fields.description: Invitations one person may send in an hour. Operators are not limited.
fields.label: Invitations per Hour

fields.description: Minutes before a pending invitation can be sent again.
fields.label: Invitation Resend Cooldown (Minutes)

fields.description: A code expires after System Settings > Login with email link expiry.
fields.label: Sign-in Codes

fields.description: Wrong codes an email may enter before it is locked until the code expires.
fields.label: Code Attempts

fields.description: Codes one email may request before the code expires.
fields.label: Codes per Email
Domains That Allow Aliases
fields.description: One domain per line. A new account on any other domain cannot use an alias such as name+tag@example.com, because every new owner gets free credit.

fields.label: Refuse Temporary Emails
fields.description: Refuse a new account on a known temporary email provider. To block another domain, add it to Blocked Email Domain.

fields.label: Signup Requests per Minute
fields.description: New-account code requests one IP address, or one organisation's email domain, may make in a minute. Above it, Central blocks that IP or domain. Public providers such as gmail.com are limited by IP only. 0 turns this off.

fields.label: Automatic Block Hours
fields.description: How long an automatic block lasts. A blocked domain is listed in Signup Domain, and the System Managers get an email.
A team needs an active payment method, or credit that covers the server, to create a server other than a free trial site. Turn it off for demos, so a complete billing profile is enough.
fields.label: Require Payment Method for Servers

fields.description: Free trial sites one owner may hold across all their teams. For a staging trial team, the servers that team may hold.
fields.label: Trial Servers Limit

fields.description: Days a trial site runs from when it is first ready. A Product can set its own.
fields.label: Trial Days

fields.description: Days a stopped trial site is kept before its server is terminated. A Product can set its own.
fields.label: Trial Deletion Days

fields.description: Days before a trial ends, and before an ended trial is deleted, that Central sends the warning email. A second warning goes out on the last day.
fields.label: Trial Notice Days
GitHub App
fields.description: Pilot benches clone private repositories with short-lived tokens of this App. Use Create GitHub App to fill these fields.
